# Support Policy

Thank you for using this installer. Please note the following support guidelines:

- **CMS Issues**: If you have issues related to the CMS itself (configuration, database setup, modules, administration,
  code errors), please contact the official support of the CMS (e.g. Bitrix help, WordPress forums, etc.). We do not
  provide support for the CMS itself.
- **Installer Issues**: If the installer script fails to download, is outdated, does not work on your environment (
  PHP/Composer version compatibility), or has other installer-specific bugs, please feel free to open an Issue on
  GitHub.
- **Questions & Discussions**: Use GitHub Discussions (if enabled) or open a Q&A issue for general questions on using
  this installer.
